question: Admit ops-metric-event-protocol as a Pilot (five-stage route) with the four criteria, the widened scope (the protocol with lifecycle, routing, sender rules and complete information with injection guard; contract v1 and the metric type landed on main; a recorded store recommendation without building it), the non-goals, a 2-day budget and the stop conditions as written? Approving accepts all of them as written, including the 2-day budget, and enters ideation on opus.

artifacts.summary: A shared key-metric event protocol owned by kc-ops-inbox, widened by the Captain on 2026-10-26: crossing, recovered and heartbeat events; environment and severity routing; sender retry and response-code rules with a per-incident cap; context pointers and enumerated values instead of free text. Lands contract v1 plus the metric type on main with relay and qnow fixtures, and records a store recommendation without building it.
